used_cfstrings.text: Could not decode object with UID %ld
Corrupt class properties in MainStage document.

definition_facts.ja: UID入口はGetValueのimport pointerが非0で、入力のCF type IDがUIDのtype IDと一致する枝。UIDをx21へ取得する。
definition_facts.en: The UID path requires a nonzero GetValue import pointer and matching CF type IDs; the extracted UID is saved in x21.

definition_facts.ja: UIDをNSNumber longのキーにし、offset32の_objectsByIDを引く。非0のcache結果は再帰復元を飛ばす。
definition_facts.en: UID becomes an NSNumber long key for _objectsByID at offset32. A nonzero cache hit skips recursive decoding.

definition_facts.ja: cache miss後、UIDの符号bitまたはUID>=encodedObjects.countでinvalid UIDのログと0結果へ進む。
definition_facts.en: After a cache miss, a negative UID or UID >= encodedObjects.count takes the invalid-UID logging path with zero result.

definition_facts.ja: 有効なUIDはoffset16の_encodedObjectsから要素を引き、self _decodedObject:を再帰送信。0結果は失敗ログへ、cacheへの格納には進まない。
definition_facts.en: A valid UID indexes _encodedObjects at offset16 and recursively sends _decodedObject: to self. A zero result logs failure and does not populate the cache.

definition_facts.ja: UID0で復元結果が文字列$nullと等しいときだけ、NSNull null結果へ置き換える。
definition_facts.en: Only UID0 whose decoded result equals the string $null is replaced with the result of NSNull null.

definition_facts.ja: 成功したUID復元は必要ならNSMutableDictionary cacheを作り、復元結果をUID keyで格納する。格納は再帰から戻った後。
definition_facts.en: Successful UID decoding creates a mutable dictionary cache if needed and stores the result by UID after recursion has returned.

definition_facts.ja: 辞書以外ではNSString/NSNumber/NSData/NSDateのisKindOfClass低bitが真なら入力を返し、それ以外は0。生のNSArrayをそのまま返す枝はない。
definition_facts.en: For non-dictionaries, a true low bit of isKindOfClass for NSString, NSNumber, NSData or NSDate returns the input; otherwise zero. No direct raw-NSArray pass-through branch exists.

definition_facts.ja: 辞書の$classが0なら$classnameを引く。それも0なら警告と0、非0ならその値を再帰復元した結果を返す。
definition_facts.en: If dictionary $class is zero, it looks up $classname. Zero there warns and returns zero; a nonzero value is recursively decoded and returned.

definition_facts.ja: 非0の$class値を再帰復元してclassForClassName:へ渡し、返されたClassのNSStringFromClass結果をFoundationのクラス名と比較する。
definition_facts.en: A nonzero $class value is recursively decoded and passed to classForClassName:. NSStringFromClass of the returned Class is compared with Foundation class names.

definition_facts.ja: NSArray/NSMutableArray、NSDictionary/NSMutableDictionary、NSString/NSMutableString、NSAttributedString/NSMutableAttributedString、NSColorの名前比較は各専用復元selectorへ進む。
definition_facts.en: Name comparisons for immutable/mutable array, dictionary, string and attributed string, plus NSColor, dispatch to the corresponding specialized decoding selectors.

definition_facts.ja: WsIdentityのsubclass比較はw0全体、MAMapping/MAKeyboardLayer/MAGraphPointはbit0、_WsChannelUUIDはw0全体で分岐。MAChannelIDは名前比較。専用helper内部はこの2本文では未読。
definition_facts.en: WsIdentity and _WsChannelUUID subclass tests branch on full w0; MAMapping, MAKeyboardLayer and MAGraphPoint test bit0. MAChannelID uses a name comparison. Specialized helper bodies are outside this two-body scope.

definition_facts.ja: 名前/専用subclass分岐を通らない辞書は各値を再帰復元したproperties辞書を作り、offset40のfileWrapperをfileWrapperキーへ入れ、固定クラス_CLgMainStageObject initWithProperties:へ渡す。任意Classをここで直接allocしてはいない。
definition_facts.en: The fallback recursively decodes each dictionary value into properties, injects fileWrapper at offset40 under the fileWrapper key, and allocates the fixed _CLgMainStageObject class with initWithProperties:, rather than directly allocating the arbitrary resolved Class.

definition_facts.ja: fallbackの各値の復元が0ならcorrupt propertiesのログを出し、全体を0結果にする。
definition_facts.en: A zero decoded property in fallback logs corrupt class properties and sets the entire result to zero.

definition_facts.ja: versionはoffset24の_rootPropertiesから_classVersionsを引いて再帰復元し、その結果をincoming classNameで引く。intValueのw0を64bitへ符号拡張して返す。局所的nil/type/default枝はない。
definition_facts.en: Version looks up _classVersions in _rootProperties at offset24, recursively decodes it, then looks up the incoming className. It sign-extends intValue w0 to64bits. No local nil/type/default branch exists.

independent_review.scope: Two fixed TARGET016 definitions only; no new callee/job/live/public edits
caveats: Selected owner metadata was revalidated directly; no claim of complete class-scan coverage or absence follows from the original skipped metadata entries.
UID cache lookup precedes invalid UID checks; cache insertion follows recursive return, with no generic pre-recursion placeholder in this body.
UID0 $null replacement compares decoded object using isEqual: and full w0; no explicit NSString class check or post-NSNull result null guard.
Fallback allocation is the fixed _CLgMainStageObject. Dedicated helper/native bodies and their allocations remain unqueried.
Native accepted types, nil/error/exception behavior, runtime dispatch, actual objects, mutation, recursion/cycles and save/reload roundtrip remain unverified.

limits: Specialized helper and fallback initializer bodies outside this scope
Native errors and exceptions, cycles, cache lifetime, effective dispatch and runtime layout unverified
